cues.en: This short video is just to introduce the next several videos, because the organization is slightly different from all the other videos in this course.

cues.en: The main question we will be addressing for the rest of the videos in this section are where embeddings matrices come from.
cues.zh: 這一章剩下的影片，要回答的主要問題，是嵌入矩陣從哪裡來。

cues.en: Well, the short answer is that embeddings matrices are trained from data using gradient descent.
cues.zh: 簡短答案是，根據資料，透過梯度下降訓練。

cues.en: And the longer answer is basically the purpose of the next half dozen videos.
cues.zh: 較長的答案，就是接下來約六支影片的目的。

cues.en: Now, one thing to keep in mind as you are going through these videos is that in real life, the embeddings
cues.zh: 觀看時，請記得，實際應用中，嵌入

cues.en: matrix is just another part of the model, and it's trained along with the rest of the model.
cues.zh: 矩陣只是模型的一部分，會和模型其餘部分一起訓練。

cues.en: So what we are going to do in the next several videos is train an embeddings matrix in a model that is not a language model.
cues.zh: 接下來，則要在一個不是語言模型的模型裡，訓練嵌入矩陣。

cues.en: So the goal of the next several videos is to get an embeddings matrix, not a full LL.
cues.zh: 目標是取得嵌入矩陣，而不是完整 LLM。

cues.en: So some of the choices that I will make in the training, for example, the text sequence length and the very small amount of training data are done for educational purposes.
cues.zh: 所以，某些訓練選擇，例如文字序列長度，以及很少的訓練資料，都是出於教學考量。

cues.en: And that means that I would like you to focus in the next several videos on the mechanisms and implementations
cues.zh: 因此，希望你在接下來幾支影片，專注於嵌入模型
